title: Dimension one generalization in locally principal support
statement: For a locally Noetherian scheme Y, a locally principal quasi-coherent ideal J, and a point y in the closed support V(J) with positive Krull dimension of its stalk, there exists a generalization y′ of y still in V(J) whose stalk has Krull dimension one.

source.place: Tag 0BJG, Lemma 58.21.1, applied to the stalk at y

proof.text: Choose an affine open U containing y on which J.ideal U is generated by d. Let p = U.primeIdealOf(y). The coordinate ring is Noetherian by IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian. IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk and IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height identify the positive dimension of the stalk at y with the positive finite height of p. IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_of_mem and IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_preimage_zeroLocus imply d belongs to p.

Choose a longest chain c ending at p, with length equal to its height, using Mathlib Ideal.exists_ltSeries_length_eq_height. Apply PrimeSpectrum.exist_ltSeries_mem_one_of_mem_last to d in its last prime. This produces a chain q of the same length and with the same last prime, and d in q(1). Its length is positive. By Order.height_eq_index_of_length_eq_height_last and PrimeSpectrum.height_eq_orderHeight, q(1) has height one. Monotonicity of q gives q(1) <= p. This replaces the dimension induction of Tag 0BJG by Mathlib's chain-reordering theorem, which uses the principal ideal theorem.

Take y-prime = U.fromSpec(q(1)). The inclusion q(1) <= p yields specialization y-prime to y by PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes and continuity of fromSpec. Since d belongs to q(1), the principal ideal J.ideal U is contained in q(1); the same zero-locus and support equivalences put y-prime in J.support. Finally IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk' and IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height identify the dimension of its stalk with the height one of q(1). No domain, reducedness, or nonzero-generator assumption is used.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_dimension_one_generalization_in_locallyPrincipal_support
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J.IsLocallyPrincipal) (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ J.support)
    (hpos : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) < ringKrullDim (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) :
    ∃ y' : Y, Specializes y' y ∧ y' ∈ J.support ∧
      ringKrullDim (Y.presheaf.stalk y') = 1
